## Notes

60 ticks per second at normal speed; speeds x3, x6, and x15 (ultrafast only in development mode); runs as close to target as hardware allows; 2,500 ticks per hour, 60,000 per day; 15-day quadrums, 4 per 60-day year; Space pauses.
